tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di bsgoms par 'dod pas khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du song nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bsgoms par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ ljang sngon las 'od 'phros pas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer sna'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod pas/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/

slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rab tu gdangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer cung zad bsdus shing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ shin tu brjid cing sprul pa du ma 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drang*/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar ba'i badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ro s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus// bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa// rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nas rab tu smras so'i bar gyis lha dang sngags kyi che ba dran par byas la/ sngags kyi dngos gzhi ci nus bzla/ a mu kaṃ zhes pa'i tshab tu gnod byed 'byung po zhes gdon/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// zhes pa nas/ rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /des ni rtag tu dge bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis cho ga'i phan yon dran pa lan gcig brjod la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de la mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa rgyas pas kyang bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pas bzod par gsol la mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// bum chog ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gtsang ma'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa'i nang du dri bzang gi chu dang*/ nor bu yungs kar dūrba dang*// rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas// shel dang zhes pa'i bcud rnams gzhug /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du bzhag de'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba dang*/ rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag la/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dkar gtor gcig cha gsum dang bcas pa bsham/

rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu yang bshams la/ mchod rdzas rnams yang snying gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta zhes sogs dang so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing mthar dril bu dkrol te byin dbab/ gong ltar bdag bskyed byas la/ bum pa yang snying gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes pa nas sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ gong ltar bstims la/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod rnams gong bzhin bya/ skabs 'di'am 'og tu gtor ma rnams dbul/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du bsgrub bya gang yin de dmigs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te/

thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bsgrub bya'i lus la thim ste nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par byas nas bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rnams kyis bum pa gang bar bsams la/ che ba dran pa lan gcig brjod de/ gzungs brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthar/ yang snying brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas la phan yon dran pa lan gcig brjod/ spro na/ tshigs bcad gang rigs dang bcas pa'am/ mi nus na gong ltar mchod bstod byas la gzungs thag bsdu/ sngar gtor ma phul ma tshar na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bgegs sbyang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la ā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis ma dag pa bsreg rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hās gtor ma 'dod dgu'i 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs pa/ lha'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ yang snying gi mthar a kā ro sbyar ba lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu gyur pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// mi phyed srung ba'i 'khor lo ni// kun nas 'bar ba'i me phung gis// bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par rgyas pa pad+mo yi// snying po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la// bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis legs bzhugs pa// rdo rje rnam 'joms dpal la 'dud// sna tshogs phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir// sku mdog mar gad ltar gsal ba// rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par spras// sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro la 'dud// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa dang*// dpa' dang brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan// dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud// sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis// nyid kyi thugs kar bsgyings nas bsnams// g.yon pas dril bu dkur 'dzin pa// rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi rigs sngags nga ro'i dbyangs// 'brug sgra stong bzhin rab bsgrags pas// bdud dpung ma lus rnam gnon zhing*// 'dod dgu'i sbyin par mdzad la 'dud// khyod thugs zab pas nyer zhi yang*// rgya che rol pas kun khyab mdzad// mi g.yo kun 'gro rtag brtan pa// ye shes dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// yon tan phrin las rin chen gyi// mi zad gter gyur mgon khyod la// rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs kyi// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab/

gtor ma lhag ma rnams cha gsum gyi cho gas btang*/ bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// khrus chog ni bsgrub bya dngos sam bris pa la sogs pa'i mdun du sbyangs chas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ las kyi rdo rjes bsgrub bya la g.yas phyogs su bskor zhing*/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs brjod de se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la zhi bas sbyang*/ de bzhin du ting lo dang changs bu bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje gsor zhing yang snying brjod pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad/ gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ spro na khro bo spyan 'dren gdan 'bul mchod bstod rnams byas pa'i mthar/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la/

rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des mgu bar gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes dang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos yang snying zlo zhing rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs la gong du khro bo spyan 'dren byas na slar yang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing sogs kyi mthar rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs sbyar ba lan gnyis te drag po'i sbyang ba lan gsum byas la/ bsgrub bya'i lus dngos sam bris pa bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs kyi mthar/ gzungs tshar gcig gi rjes su yang snying gi mthar/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bigh+nan= sarba ro ge= sarba duṣ+ṭā na= sarba gra he= sarba dz+wa re= sarba byā dhi= sarba u pa dra we= sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu= sarba dur+sop+ni= sarba durni mit+ta= sarba tsi ta ku le bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o// byabs pa ni rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su zla ba la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsams la/ des bsgrub bya'i nad rims gdon bgegs rnams rdo khab len gyis lcags len pa ltar blangs te phyir dor bar bsams la/ yang snying gi mthar/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥ.a pa na ya swā hā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar te byab bo// de nas slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i ched du spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la yang snying gi mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes brjod/ spro na/ lus kyi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su yang rdo rjes reg cing lus la rdo rje'i go gyon par bsams la/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes sogs sbyar la bsrungs te gzungs rdzogs pa tshar gcig brjod la/

rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ rol mo'i sgra dang bkra shis bya'o// rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le byas la tshom bu bkod chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang*/ me tog la sogs pa sta gon bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas la/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul la mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas snyims pa me tog dang bcas 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol zhes pas gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la gzhi 'god pa'i slad du swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyang*/ de'i ngang las slob ma rnam 'joms su bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs te slob ma la thim par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥzhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi bar chad zhi bar byas/ lus rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi skur byas snyam du mos/ rjes gnang dngos la/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/

sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ slob ma rdo rje rnam 'joms su gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par bsams la/ che ba brjod pa tshar gcig bklag gzungs dngos kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug phan yon dran pa tshar gcig bklags la/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ des gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gi bar chad zhi bar byas/ ngag rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gsung du byas snyam du mos/ byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re byon te/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim par bsams la lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad cing*/ mthar rtog med du bzhag bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// zhes sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ rjes zlos rnams lan gsum gsum bya/ rjes gnang dang 'brel bar khrus chog byed na/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod tshar ba'i rjes su/ gong du bshad pa'i bum chog byas la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung yan chad gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ sbyang ba nas brtsams te/ bkru byabs srung gsum bkra shis kyi bar bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus la dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'di/

slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab la gzhi byas te shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bkod pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bai dā ra nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis rdo rje'i khro bo las byung ba/ rdo rje'i snying po rab tu smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa sen pa ta ye/
tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghūr+ṇa ghūr+ṇa/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba satwā ni/ bo dha bo dha/

dpe gcig la/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ snang*/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trū nāṃ/ gha ṭa gha ta/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa ha sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya swā hā/ he phul+lu/ ni ru phul+lu/ gṛh+ṇa phul+lu/ dpe gcig la kul+lu snang*/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ kī li kī li ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ ma hā kī li ma hā badz+ra zhes snang kī lā ya swā hā/ bhan+dha ban+dha/ kro dha kro dha kro dha ma hā kī li sogs snang*/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ ma ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ shru tis+thi ra badz+ra/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha ra ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā brta ya swā hā/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba ba la mā brta ya/ sarba badz+ra ku la ma brta ya/ zhes snang*/ ma hā ba le/ ka ta be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa/ ra ṇa ra ṇa zhes snang*/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ tiṅga le/ piṅga la/ zhes snang*/ da ha da ha/ te dzo ba ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ na mo ran tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*// phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*// lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*// mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*// bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*// phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*// nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*// 'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems dang*// mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*// mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi// rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*// de ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis// mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya// gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi// mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*// de dag thams cad zhi bar blta// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// sdig pa kun las rnam par thar// nor bu nyungs kar dūr+wa dang*// rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas// shel dang rdo rje me tog dang*// chu yi gser ram yang na ni// dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkri zhing dgang*// lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad// rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni// rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so//

༈ /rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rgya chen tshogs gnyis dpung gi rgyal thabs kyis// mi bzad bdud kyi g.yul ngo rab bcom nas// mtha' yas skye dgu kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// thub dbang shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus nas// sa gsum gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje 'dzin// rgyal bas mngon sum byin rlabs dze tā ri// dgra las rnam rgyal bzang po la= /'phags yul mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// thub pa'i rgyal tshab rdo rje gdan pa che// gang des rjes bzung dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i// paṇa chen don yod rdo rje la= /rmad byung tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sems dpa' che// mtshungs med sgra sgyur lo tsā ba ri'i zhabs// rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin pa'i// brtse chen kun dga' snying po la= /skye dgu'i skyabs gcig 'jig rten rgyan gyur pa// 'ja' lus mngon gyur bsod nams rtse mo dang*// gsang chen bstan pa rgyas mdzad rdo rje 'dzin// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la= /smra ngan mu stegs gzhung lugs pham mdzad cing*// 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug brgyan paṇ+ḍi ta// zab rgyas chos dang srid pa'i dpal yon can// chos rgyal blo gros rgyal mtshan la= /sngon sbyangs bsod nams chen pos bskrun pa'i sku// dbang phyug brgyad ldan rnams dang dbyer med cing*// dam chos rin chen du ma'i dpal gyis mdzes// bla chen rin chen dpal ba la= /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i brtul zhugs can// byang chub thugs 'byongs bo dhi ku mā ra// dpag med 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje can// byang chub seng ge'i zhabs la= /ye shes lnga ldan mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgreng mdzad cing*// skye dgu kun la dga' bzhi'i lam bzang po// ston mkhas lung bstan brnyes pa la=

/chos kun dga' bzhi'i ngo bor ro gcig rtogs// rmad byung rgyud sde kun gyi dbang phyug che// grub pa'i bka' babs gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa// yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba la= /lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma mchog rnams kyis// rjes bzung lung bstan brnyes pa seng ge'i mtshan// rgyal ba'i phrin las kun la dbang sgyur ba'i// rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub la= /shes bya'i gnas kun ma lus rab mkhyen nas// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i chos kyi rje// rig gnas kun la mkhyen pa dge ba can// paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la= /rin chen byang chub sems kyi dpal dang ldan// rgyud sde'i don gzigs grub pa'i sar gshegs pa'i// shes rab mig stong ldan pa kun gyi rje// dam chos rin chen 'byung gnas= /gang gi zhal las dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud// gsol bas rtse gcig bsam gtan grub gyur nas// zab gsal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa// brtse chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs la= /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rgyal ba kun las bka' drin ches lhag pa'i// tha mal gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la= /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje khro bo pho nya drug cu sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal dang de sras la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// thog med dus nas bdag gis sdig pa'i las// dpag med bgyis gang 'dren pa'i spyan sngar bshags// rgyal dang rgyal sras so so skye bo yi// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// ma dag 'khor ba'i bya bas ldongs rnams la// rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// thub mchog mya ngan 'da' ba gang bzhed pa// skyes mchog de dag bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// bsam yas dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma gyur 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// 'dren pa mnyam med bla ma'i tshogs rnams las// zab rgyas dam tshigs bdud rtsi legs thob nas// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde sgrub par shog

/dam chos sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen tshogs// nad gdon rims dang bgegs rigs nyer 'tshe dang*// gzhan gyi rig sngags rbad 'dre mnan gtad sogs// pha rol gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// rgyal po kun kyang chos bzhin spyod gyur cig /sbyin bdag rnams kyi chos dang mthun pa'i don// ma lus yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// lus can rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// 'khrugs rtsod gnod sems mu ge nad rims sogs// ma lus zhi nas dga' bde'i dpal ldan zhing*// phun tshogs dge legs rgyas par mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten khams kun lo phyugs legs pa dang*// longs spyod 'phel zhing sdig pa'i las spangs nas// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*// rnam dkar dge ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*// chos kun de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// ji ltar gsol ba'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni tshul gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas tshul khrims dang*/ gzhan yang blo ldan mang pos nye bar bskul ba'i ngor/ bya bral bas e waṃ gtsug lag khang du bris pa'o// ༈ /brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ brtse chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i mtshams/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon mtho zhing*// gzhan don phrin las lhun grub smra ba'i dbang*// mtha' klas bstan dang 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu// mtshungs med dpal ldan chos skyong la= /ngag gi dbang phyug chos bzhin 'doms mkhas pa// lung rtogs bstan pa skyong mdzad dpal bzang po// dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// ngag dbang bsod nams bstan 'dzin la= /mkhas kun dga' bskyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*// dmigs med thugs rje'i gter chen chos kyi rje// tshul gnas gsan bsam mthar son theg mchog gi

/bshes gnyen ngag dbang brtan pa la= /ngag la dbang 'byor phyi nang rig gzhung gi /legs bshad rgya mtsho smra la bzla med pa// mkhas btsun grub pa'i dpal mnga' rdo rje 'dzin// 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid sogs dang sbrel lo// ces pa'ang 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos so// ༈ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rjes gnang sogs ji ltar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang sogs ji ltar byed pa'i tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le byas la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa phyogs mtshams brgyad dang gtor ma mdun dang*/ cha gsum shar lho nas lho nub bar dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog bum pa/ gzungs rdor/ yungs kar/ gu gul/ slob ma la bkye rgyu'i me tog sogs sta gon bya/ mchod pa byin brlab/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed de// mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba/ cha gsum gtor ma/ bum bskyed bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa/ gsol ba gdab pa rnams thams cad mkhyen pa rat+na ni rā bho gas mdzad pa ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa las/ bsdu na rgyu la yun ring du spyod par byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu la myur du spyod par byed pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la yang rgyud sde gnyis dang*/ gsum dang bzhi dang*/ lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa las/ slob dpon kha cig bsdu ba tsam mdzad/ kha cig dbye ba tsam mdzad pa ni/ brjod bya'i don phyogs ris mthun pa tsam la dgongs pa yin/ don la rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi las/ 'dir bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la yang bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba so so'i rgyud gnyis la/ 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la rgyud sde sgo drug yod pa las/ 'dir rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la lnga ste/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud ni rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs te 'di la slob dpon dze tā ris lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bshad do// gnyis pa rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud ni/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud dang*/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ lag na rdo rje'i gzungs chog dang bcas pa dang*/ lag na rdo rje sa bcu'i snying po dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs dang*/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i gzungs dang*/

lag na rdo rje rmi lam mthong ba'i gzungs dang dgu'o// gsum pa rigs kyi yum ni/ rdo rje mi pham ma me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs so// bzhi pa khro bo khro mo ni/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang*/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can dang gnyis so// lnga pa phyag brnyan pho mo'i rgyud ni/ stobs po che'i gzungs dang*/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi rtog pa gnyis te de ltar kun dril bas rgyud bco lnga yod pa las/ 'dir rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud yin/ de la dgu yod pa'i nang nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ de'ang de nyid las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// zhes pa'i tshig la brten nas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ bya rgyud rang rkang du bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sogs yod/ yang de nyid la brten nas slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas spyod rgyud ltar bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sogs yod/ yang tshig de nyid la brten nas grub chen dze tā ris rnal 'byor rgyud ltar bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha gcig bum gcig bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i lugs dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ṇi badz+ra gyis rdo rje rnam 'joms sngon po lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bka' srol sogs du ma yod do// yang de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pas rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud ltar bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms la khro bo bcu dang rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba de nyid rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa la rnam 'joms bir lugs zhes yongs su grags pa rnams su yod pa las/

'dir grub chen dze tā ri nas bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba la sogs par brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba legs par grub zin nas/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la rdo rje rnam 'joms dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zab mo'i zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas/ me tog gtor ba'i bar 'dra/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de'i mtha' rten du gdon bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba sogs bya ba dang*/ bgegs zhi ba'i phyir bkru byabs srung gsum du gnas pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa dang*/ shes par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ dang po gdon bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs brjod/ ting lo dang changs bus kyang sbyong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa sogs dang*/ drag po'i sgo nas sbyong ba sogs dang*/ gnyis pa bgegs zhi ba'i phyir bkru byabs srung gsum las thog mar bkru ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas sku khrus gsol bar mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ byabs pa'i slad du rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la hūm̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba gsal btab nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sgros khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags len pa ltar tsen gyis blangs te phyir dor bar mos pa mdzod/

yang snying sogs dang*/ bsrung ba'i slad du khyed rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su slob dpon gyi rdo rjes rig pas rdo rje de las de 'dra ba'i rigs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste lus la rdo rje'i go gyon nas phyin chad bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yang snying sogs dang*/ gsum pa bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i slad du khyed rang gi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ngag tu gzungs dang*/ rgyal ba sogs dang*/ bzhi pa shes par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba slob dpon dang bcas pas bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bya'o// rjes gtso bos sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ rjes chog la mchod pa kha gsos nas byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ gshegs su gsol zhing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ gnas gsum srung ba sogs 'dra'o// zhes pa 'di ni rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i kha skong du/ skul ba po'i bzhed pa ltar dang rang gi dran pa gso ba'i phyir du brang ti pa'i btsun pa nam mkha'i ming can gyis e waṃ thar pa rtser myur bar sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// ༈ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa sogs kyi gsal byed nyer mkho snying por dril ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya/ mtha' yas pa'i rig sngags la las kyi nus pa 'byin byed khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/ bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigs dang gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'di'i rjes gnang man ngag gi lung dang bcas pa thob cing*/

dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ gnas dben zhing rang dbang 'dus pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur zla ba gang yang rung ba'i mar ngo'i gza' skar sbyor byed shis pa'i nyin phyag dar legs par bya/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod lhur len pas/ rang gi mdun du 'di'i bris 'bur gyi sku yod na bsham/ gtor ma 'bul na de'i spyan sngar 'das gtor dang*/ phyogs 'byung bcas breng tshar du bsgrigs pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ nyin re bzhin 'dor rgyu'i bgegs gtor/ nye logs ci bde bar cha gsum gcig mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad tshags su tshud par bya/ de nas dgong thun la babs pa na/ thog mar gdan gzhan zhig la 'dug ste/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs chos spyod rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyi mthar cha gsum btang la mtshams bcad pa'i rjes rang gi mal du zhugs/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bya/ bzlas dmigs ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje langs thabs su gnas pa'i shar gyi rwa dkar po 'og tu zug pa/ lte ba shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su hūm̐ yig ljang sngon bar snang la lding thabs su 'khod pa de'i khog pa'i mdun nas brtsams te gzungs ring snying po/ yang snying rnams g.yas skor du sbrul 'khyil pa ltar bkod/ legs par gsal thebs pa dang*/ rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dang snying ga'i sngags phreng gsal zhing 'od zer 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ thog mar che ba dran pa tshar gcig gzungs yongs rdzogs tshar gsum sogs ci nus dang*/ yang snying na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa gtso bor byas te bzla/ rtsa ba'i bzlas dmigs gcig kho nas sems skyo na/ skabs rer sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/

nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la bzla/ yang 'od zer me lce lta bus gdon bgegs 'byung po'i rigs thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ de dag gi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad rang la thim par bsam ste bzla bar yig cha phyi ma 'ga' zhig tu bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung bar sems/ thun bsdu ba na phan yon dran pa tshar gcig rjes/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la mchod bstod mdor bsdus nas gshegs gsol bya ba'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ gtor ma 'bul na/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs rnams bum mchog ltar bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams bum chog gi skabs ltar dang*/ cha gsum spyi ltar btang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ gang ltar yang*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo smon dang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa byas te rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam la 'jug go /de lta bu'i rim pas thun gsum mam bzhis yang snying 'bum phrag bzhi dang*/ khri phrag bzhi 'gro nges bya/ gtor ma thun gsum du byed na nyin gung gi thun gyi mtha' dang*/

bzhir byed na dgongs thun gyi rjes la 'bul/ gal srid spros pas ma lcog na bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir gtor ma ma phul kyang 'gal ba med par gsungs/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg ni zhu chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul/ bsnyen pa rgyas par byed na gzungs ring 'bum phrag bzhi dang*/ yang snying 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa bzla bar gsungs kyang deng sang lag len du 'debs pa ni gong du smos pa bzhin no// gzhan mtshams kyi skabs spang blang sogs rgyud sde 'og ma'i bsnyen thabs spyi 'gro ltar shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// de ltar bsnyen pa las su rung bas gzhan don bum pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga ni dkyus su gsal ba bzhin la/ bum rdzas kyi ngos 'dzin rgya gzhung du grags pa rnams las cung zad mi 'dra bar gsungs kyang*/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan la/ nor bu zhes 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel lam/ mu tig mig ma phug pa la bzhed pa'ang snang bas gang 'byor dang*/ rgyal po yungs kar khro zhal can/ rgya bal nas 'byung ba'i dūrba dngos sam rtswa ram pa'i rtsa ba/ rin chen rma med ces gser sogs rang byung rdog po dang*/ byi ru sogs gas chag med cing bzo ma byas pa gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa zhig dgos pa de lta bu gang 'byor/ tsan+dan dkar po dri nus ma yal ba/ rang byung gi shel dngos sam rdo shel lta bu gang rigs gas chag med pa rnams ma nyams par dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i bum pa'i chu la btab pa'am/ ras gtsang ma'i nang du thum por byas te lto bar 'jug ku sha rma bya'i mdongs dang bcas pas kha brgyan pa'i khar dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba dang gzungs thag rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa btags pa bzhag go /khrus kyi cho ga la/ zhi ba'i tshul ni dkyus su gsal/ rgyas pa'i las sgrub na/ bsgrub bya'i lus dngos sam bris pa dngos su'am me long la shar ba bkru zhing*/
gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

tshe rgyas par mdzod cig puṇ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ bsod nams rgyas par mdzod cig zhes pa lta bu sbyar ba dang*/ dbang la rgyal po dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta sogs dmigs bya gang yin gyi ming spel la/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes sbyar/ drag po la gnod byed 'byung bo mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa lta bu sbyar nas bkrus pas las de dang de 'grub par gsungs/ sbyin sreg gis las sgrub pa'i tshul ni 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don zhu chen paṇ+ḍi tas gsal bar mdzad pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// des na skabs 'di'i man ngag las 'byung ba ni de tsam ste/ gzhan du slob dpon las kyi rdo rje sogs nas brgyud pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams su las kyi cho ga bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa ni de dag gi steng du rtogs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan mang po la phan pa'i bsam pas bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ ༈ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par rnam 'byed ha nu man+tha zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mthu stobs thogs med 'bar ba'i mtshun za yis// bgegs rkyen mun nag bsti ba'i gnas phrogs nas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khams// yongs khyab bla ma ye shes me lhas skyongs// bsnyen sogs dag par bgyis pa'i rig sngags 'chang*// don gnyis sgrub la 'jug gi gzhan pas min// dar babs skyes bu'i rtsal gyis bteg pa'i khur// chen po bus pas mi 'os pa min nam// gzungs sngags zab mo'i yongs rtse bzlas pa'i grangs// tshad du yong ye phyin pa'i rnal 'byor par// sreg blugs cho ga'i lag pa 'di yod na// dngos grub snye ma len la dka' ba ci// de la 'dir bya ba'i rgyud rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mchog rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi don du las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/

spyir 'di dag la 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ cho ga ni spyi dang mtshungs pa nyid do// de lta na'ang khyad par cung zad yod pa ni 'chad pa po'i ngag las shes par bya'o// zhes khyad par brjod pa tsam ma gtogs spyi 'gro gzhan ltar bya bar gsungs pa ltar brjod pa la/ tshul 'di'i sbyor pa thab dang yo byad bsham// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed phal mchog me lha mchod// rjes ni mchod cing bzod par gsol te gshegs// bkra shis dbyangs kyis mtha' mar brgyan bya'o// zhes pa ltar gyi thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sbyor ba la/ sa gzhi mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad kyis zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung zhing*/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis kyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzoms nas zur bzhir mtshan ma btsal te stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/ mu ran rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad tshon dmar skyas bya/ thab dbus nas sum gcig lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i mdun mtshan dkar po nub tu 'ong ba bri'o// gnyis pa yo byad bsham pa ni/ mu ran gyi steng nas bud shing 'o ma can nam/ srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po zlum por brtsig de'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo che ba bzhag nub nas sgrub pa po zhal shar du phyogs par 'gyur ba'i stan nang tshang can dkar po btings pa'i mdun du me yol pha gu la dkar rtsis byugs pa dang*/ mdun du stegs kyi khar rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar dang blugs gzar kha sbyar dang bsang chu 'thor yab bcas bzhag sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs nas rim par yam shing 'o ma can gyi rigs/ mar khu/ til lam yungs kar te bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo de gsum gyis chog par bshad/

de'ang bsreg rdzas so sor 'os pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i me lha la sngon du nyer gcig lta bu ji tsam 'bul ba de'i grangs dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la brgya rtsa dang lhag ma bdun sogs gang dgos rnams tshar gnyis so sor bshams nas byin rlabs dus gcig tu byed pa ni phyag len shin tu legs par mngon/ g.yon logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod dang 'das gtor dang me lha'i zlum gtor gnyis bsham mo// dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang por bdag bskyed pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus la sogs par zhwa gos dkar pos brgyan te skyil krung ngam rig byed gdon pa lta bu'i spyod lam dang ldan pas rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa'i sems dang ldan pas 'khod de/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs skyabs su 'gro ba nas brtsams te bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ thog mar bsang chu/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa sogs yang snying lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te bzhag 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bya'o// de nas rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar lag pa gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas thab la g.yas nas zlum por lan gsum du bskor zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod cing me tshang du gzhug la rtswa skam sogs dang bcas pas me sbar/ de nas dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis bzung nas blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi khar reg pas mar khu bud shing la khyab par blugs te me gso/ skabs 'dir me pra ngan na bsang chu yang snying brjod pas gtor/ de nas bsang chu rdzas rnams la gtor zhing yang snying gis bsang*/

swa bhā ba sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da swā hā'i bar dang*/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swā swā hās 'bru rnams bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās sbyangs te byin gyis brlab/ thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam zhing hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas thab kyi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la ram̐ las byung ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyug gu rtse gsum pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ drang srong gi cha lugs can/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes brjod pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang*/ ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod cing thab kyi mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas skor du dgram mo/ de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi kha'i ram̐ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ba mthar dgang blugs gnyis kha sbyar te/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba h+na ya swā hā/ zhes pas me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod/ ghaṇ+ṭā+e ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// mi lha'i rgyal po dā kis dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab me yis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas len cing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul ba'i tshul bya ste/ de'ang rdzas thams cad 'bul sngags/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis yam shing lan bdun nam nyer gcig phul mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes gdags/

sbyin bdag gi don du bya ba'i tshe spel tshig gang 'tshams kha bsgyur shes par bya'o// de bzhin du mar dang*/ til lam yungs kar rnams kyang sngags de nyid dang mthar spel tshig sbyar ba bcas phul/ de nas mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par 'gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis srung ba'i 'khor lo lha dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang bcas par dmigs la/ de thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing brjod/ gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha dad med par dmigs la/ gzar bu gnyis blangs nas lha rnams zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje sogs sngar bzhin bsams la/ yang snying lan gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis mar khu phul mthar/ ā dī pyā dī bya sogs bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs spel tshig gong bzhin brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas spro na/ mchod yon phal cher la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar so so'i phyag rgyas dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas so so'i kha bsgyur ba dang bcas pas shab+da'i bar dharmā ra ṇi rol mo bcas pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// zhes sogs kyis bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams bya'o// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas thams cad yang snying 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsar dbul zhing sde tshan re re'i mthar spel tshig gdags/

de'ang yam shing 'bar ba'i me la'o// zhu ba'i rdzas zhal dang gong bu'i rdzas phyag tu 'bul lo// de nas til mdun du bzhag pa la bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa kam̐ yig nag po'i rnam par bsdus nas bstim/ slar yang de'i steng a yig dkar po zhig bsams te/ de'i 'od zer til la phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ yang snying brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i til 'bul/ sgrub g.yogs gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi mar dang yam shing gis me rgyun gso/ slar yang byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags gong ltar spel ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya'o// gtor ma chab kyis bran la 'das gtor bum chog gi skabs ltar phul nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang 'dod don zhu/ spro na cha gsum gtor ma'ang btang la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ thab kyi thal ba nas srin lag gis cung zad blangs pa dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rjes la gnyis kyi dang po mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ slar yang 'bar ba'i me me lha'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs su phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul/ me lha'i gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad du gyur pa nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu 'dod don gang yin zhu/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga 'khrul pa dang*/ yo byad dman pa la sogs pa skyon du gyur pa thams cad bzod cing sbyang bar mdzad du gsol lo// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa gshegs gsol dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb srin se gol dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ni thal ba 'phral du 'phyags pas btub kyi/ mchog sgrub pa la ni me nam mnal gyi bar mi bsgul/ me mnal nas thal ba phyags la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam ri rtse la sogs par bskyal lo// shing 'phel 'bar ba'i khyim du ye shes lha// sreg blugs mgron du gnyer byas de nas bzung*// sdig sgrib nye zho'i phyogs brgya cig car du// zhi byed las kyi pho nya dang po yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i zhi ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// de nyid gzhir bzhag ri klung gser ldan ma'i// dus kyi dga' ston ji bzhin sde bzhi'i dpal// kun nas ches cher rgyas byed sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// gnyis pa rang gzhan don du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/

cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod par bya'o// de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs yangs par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas khru gang gi tshad kyis phyogs bzhir mtshan ma byas la/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma'i steng du bzung nas g.yas pas zur bzhi'i thig la mtshan ma btsal/ de'i steng thig bzhi btab pas thab khung dang*/ slar yang de'i steng sor brgyad pa gnyis bskyed pa'i mtshan ma btsal te thig gnyis re btab pas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ thab nang gi dbus nas sum gcig zlum por bskor ba lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis bskor bas pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog ser po la bcad tshon li khris bya/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba bri/ lha gnas su sna tshogs rdo rje bri bar bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad ni/ kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim po'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba'am/ med na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po gru bzhir brtsig shar lhor me tshang dang*/ lhor sgrub pa po'i gdan sogs bsham/ g.yas logs nas yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing las sbom phra gung mo tsam/ srid du khru gang ba/ rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad sogs/ mar dang*/ tshe rgyas pa la dūrba'i myu gu/ longs spyod rgyas pa la zho mar mngar gsum sogs sbags pa'i zas mchog khyim gyi 'byor pa rgyas pa la 'bru sna tshogs/ shes rab rgyas pa la dri bzang po dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ril bu rnams skabs su gang 'tsham bsham/ g.yon logs nas mchod gtor sngar bzhin bsham mo// dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid gos rgyan ser pos brgyan te/ rang gzhan gyi tshe bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas par byas te tshims pa'i bsam pas/ kha byang du phyogs pa ras 'ja' li la sogs par khyel 'dug gis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/

thog mar bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa nas lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bslab pa'i bar 'dra/ dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas nas bskor ba sogs nas/ dgang blugs khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis brkyangs pa'am/ de gnyis rtse sbyar ba rin chen khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams 'dra/ thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khungs ser po gru bzhi rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thog pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas me lha sku mdog ser po sogs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro ba zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ bdag gam sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sogs gdags pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/ de thams cad 'dzum zhing tshims pa/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad ces pa dang*/ spel tshig ni/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams sogs brjod pa dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab zas mchog 'ong ba ma gtogs 'dra/ grangs ni brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ rdzas ni gtso bo zas mchog la grangs bzung ba dang*/ spel tshig rgyas pa byed pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi skabs 'dod gsol la me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa tsam las gzhan thams cad zhi ba ltar bya'o// gzi brgya 'bar ba mtshun za'i dkyil 'khor du// lha mchog gya nom mchod pas mnyes byas pas// tshe dpal bsod nams stobs sogs rdzogs ldan dpal// skyed byed las kyi dpag bsam gnyis pa yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rab rgyas sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// zhi ba gzhir gzhag chos dang srid 'byor gyis// khengs ldan brtan pa phun tshogs skyes dang bcas// dbang byed me na ka 'dra'i sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// gsum pa rang gzhan gyi don du dbang gi sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs la thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum 'phags pa'i sar thab dbus kyi mtshan ma byas la khru phyed kyi tshad kyis/ g.yon pas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i steng du srad bu bzung*/ g.yas pas me nas dbang ldan bar gyi theg la reg par g.yas skor du bskor/ slar yang de'i khar sor bzhi bzhi bskyed pa lan gnyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran te/ shar gyi thig rtse so sor sbrel pa'i thig btag pas zla gam gyi dbyibs 'byung*/ nub kyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor phrad pa nas dbus bar gyi tshad des zur bzhir mtshan ma byas pa'i steng nas thig gru bzhir btab/ de'i khar yang sor bzhi bskyed la zur bzhir mtshan ma dang thig btab pas thab stegs so// thab nang pad+ma sogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ gzhi tshon dmar po la bcad tshon dkar pos bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan par bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad ni/ bud shing ni me tog dmar po can nam/ med na nags kyi lci bas zla gam du brtsig shar du sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can sogs 'dra/

rang gi g.yas logs nas/ yam shing*/ seng ldeng*/ mdzo mo shing*/ se ba/ shug pa sogs dmar po rtse ma nyams pa/ rked pa'i cha las byung ba/ sbom phra sor mo tsam dang srid du chag do pa/ mar ni smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba tsha ba'i mar khu cung zad bsres pa/ rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog dmar po'am/ 'bras bu dmar po/ med na tsan+dan dmar po sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ g.yon logs nas gi wang*/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dmar po sogs btab pa'i mchod yon dang*/ chu gtsang gi zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i nyer spyod dang*/ gtor ma smug rtsis byugs pa bsham/ dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ phyi dro'i dus su gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan te/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa dbang du byas te/ byang chub kyi lam la dgod par bya snyam pas chags shing 'dun pa'i bsam pas kha nub tu bltas te pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa sogs 'dra/ me ni rgyal po'am/ smad 'tshong ma'am/ chang 'tshong ma'am/ btso blag mkhan gyi me'am/ kun tu rgyus lam du bus pa'i mes bya/ dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas nas bskor ba sogs 'dra/ dgang blugs khu tshur bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar ba pad+ma'i 'dab ltar byas pa pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba ma gtogs 'dra/ thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar por zla gam rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la pad+ma'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas me lha sku mdog dmar po sogs nas/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba zhes dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i skye 'gro mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes gdags pa ma gtogs gzhan 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/

me 'bar ba'i klong du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/ de thams cad chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas yul 'khor dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i skye 'gro thams cad chags shing 'dun pa'i las mdzad ces dang*/ dbang gi spel tshig gdags pa dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab me tog dmar pos bya ba dang*/ grangs ni lnga bcu dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog la grangs bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe/ 'dod gsol la me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa skye 'gro mang po chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa tsam las gzhan thams cad zhi ba ltar bya'o// srid zhi'i me lha dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyi// yid bsgyur dmar ba'i mkhur tshos ngom tsam nas// stobs 'byor che dgu'i snying gi mdza' na mo// 'gugs byed las kyi 'jo sgeg gsum pa yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dbang gi sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// zhi ba gzhir bzhag sdang dgra gdon dang bgegs// skad cig gnyis par 'tsho ba rung ngam zhes// za byed zhugs lce rkyong pa sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// bzhi pa bstan pa rin po che dang sems can yongs la sdang zhing tho btsams pa'i dgra bgegs sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs tshar gcad pa'i phyir drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ sa chog byas pa'i sa gzhir thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas sor drug dang sor mo gcig gi sum gnyis kyi tshad kyis zlum por lan gnyis/ de'i phyir so drug pa gnyis kyis lan gnyis bskor/ zlum skor gnyis pa dang byang gi tshangs thig 'dzom sar g.yon pas srad bu bzung*/

de dang lte ba'i bar gyi tshad des shar nub kyi zlum skor la rtags bya/ byang ngos su de gnyis sbrel ba'i thig btab/ de gnyis dang shar lho'i tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzoms sar sbrel ba'i thig btab pas gru gsum 'byung ba thab nang dang*/ zlum skor phyi ma gnyis kyi steng nas kyang de ltar byas nas thig btab pas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung ngo*// zlum skor phyi ma'i tshad kyis phyi rol du thab stegs gru bzhir gdab/ nang gi zlum skor dang po'i sum gnyis pad 'dab dang sum gcig gis lte ba bya/ thab kyi gzhi tshon thams cad kha dog nag po la bcad tshon sngo skyas bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa bri/ gnyis pa yo byad ni/ kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing tsher ma can dang*/ gzhan yang bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs la sogs pa gru gsum du brtsig nang gi shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag byang du sgrub pa po'i stan sogs 'dra/ de'i g.yas logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod gtor ma gnyis/ g.yon logs nas yam shing drag po'i shing nag cing 'khyog pa/ dri mi zhim pa rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba/ sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam dang srid sor bcu pa drug cu lhag bcas dang*/ nyer gcig pa'am bdun pa tshan gcig mar ram tsha ba'i mar khu/ rdzas kyi gtso bo yungs kar dang*/ ske tshe/ dug sna tshogs rnams bsham mo// dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ nyin phyed dang mtshan phyed kyi dus su gos rgyan nag pos brgyan te/ bgegs la sogs pa tshar bcad pa'i bsam pas kha lhor phyogs par rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'am/ yang na g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i phyed krung gi spyod lam gyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa sogs 'dra/ me ni gdol pa'am shan pa'i khyim gyi me'am/

rdo'am lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i me la sbar ba'i dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun pa'i gru gsum du g.yon nas lan gsum bskor ba sogs dang*/ dgang blugs lag g.yas g.yon bzlog ste rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs/ mdzub mo bsgrengs pa'i khro bo'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams 'dra/ thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa/ rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rdo rje rtse gsum par gdengs pa'i phreng bas mtshan cing drag po'i bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ me lha sku mdog nag po sogs nas 'od zer nag po 'phro zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la tho btsams pa'i dgra bgegs zhes sam/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu skabs su gang bab bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/ de thams cad gnag cing rab tu khros pa/ 'od zer nag po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can la 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces pa dang*/ drag po'i spel tshig gong ltar dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab yungs kar ske tshe/ dug snas byed pa ma gtogs 'dra/ 'bul ba'i tshe lag pa g.yon pas 'bul ba dang*/ grangs ni drug cu dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo dug sna sogs la grangs bzung ba dang*/ drag po'i spel tshig bsgyur ba ma gtogs mchog gi me lha'i dam tshig pa rang la thim pa'i bar thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe gzhan dang 'dra ba las 'dod gsol la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la tho btsams pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs sam/ chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol zhes pa tsam las gzhan bkra shis kyi cho gas mtha' brgyan pa'i bar rjes kyi chos thams cad zhi ba dang 'dra bar bya'o// thun mong dngos grub tsam la zhi ba la 'o ma dang*/ rgyas pa la gur gum gyi chu dang*/ dbang la tsan+dan dmar po'i chu dang*/ drag po la dug chus me bsad la 'phral du phyags te thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs la bkra shis kyi me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// chos dang sems can sdang byed tsher ma'i nags// za byed rngam pa'i me lce srid rtsi'i bar// 'khyug pas dus mtha'i zhugs kyang sgron me ltar// bgyid pa las kyi dug me bzhi pa'o// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mngon spyod sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// smras pa/ sngon rabs mkhas pa'i legs bshad a sho kaḥ /nyams blang bde ba'i 'dab phreng ma grol bar// blo gros sgeg mo'i rkang rtses bsnun pa'i 'phral// rnam gsal 'dab brgyad dgod pa'i ltad mo byung*// ye shes snang ba dam pas 'og min bar// khyab par gsal ba sreg blugs cho ga yi// ngo mtshar rjes su mnyan phyir mtsho byung ma// longs spyod 'khor lor dgyes dgur rtsen nam snyam// 'dir 'bad rnam dkar dge bas rig sngags 'chang*// bzlas bsgom nus pa grub pa'i gom stabs kyis// ye shes lnga ldan grong du legs phyin nas// sa gsum chos kyi snang chen 'gyed par shog /ces rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par rnam 'byed ha nu man+thas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi bzhed pa nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar ba 'gro la phan par gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnam 'joms bum chog la nye bar mkho ba'i lhan thabs bzhugs so// na mas+sarba man+d+ra sh+tsa tan+t+rā ṇāṃ sat+yār+ya badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ba ri lugs kyi bum chog gi gsal byed lhan thabs ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su gzhan dkyus bzhin la/ khyad par gyi rdzas brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin la/ mkhas pa gzhan gyi yig char/ dūrba dang yungs kar gnyis ma gtogs gzhan drug po bum par blug rgyu la/ rdo rje ni rdo rje pha lam/ me tog ni ut+pal la sogs pa'i me tog sngon po gang rnyed la bzhed cing*/ dūrba ni bum pa'i kha rgyan ku sha sogs dang lhan cig tu 'dzugs pa dang*/ yungs kar ni bgegs skrod pa'i phyir snod du blugs nas bum pa'i khar 'jog par bshad mod/ rang lugs 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bum chog tu/ nor bu yungs kar dūrba dang*// rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas// shel dang zhes pa'i bcud rnams gzhug /zhes 'byung bas rdo rje dang me tog ni gzungs thag gi rdo rje dang me tog gi phreng ba gnyis la bzhed cing*/ lhag ma drug po bum pa'i nang du gzhug par dngos su gsal/ de la nor bu ni 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel la ngos 'dzin/ yungs kar ni rgyal po yungs kar zhes pa'i khro zhal can dang*/ dūrba ni rgya mon nas byung ba'i dngos sam ram pa'i rtsa ba gang rung*/ rin chen rma med ni rin po che gang rung ma chag cing bzo ma byas pa/ gzhan du longs ma spyad pa zhig dgos pas rdo rje pha lam mam/ 'byor sla ba gser rdog rtsing pa thig hrug zhes zer ba sa 'og nas byung ma thag pa'am/ mu tig mig ma phug pas bya/ tsan+da ni dkar po dang*/ shel ni shel rigs kyi nor bu chu shel la sogs pa gang rnyed dam/ ma 'byor na shel rdo lta bus chog cing ma chag pa sogs byung na legs/ de rnams ras thum lta bur byas nas bum pa'i lto bar gzhug tsan+dan gyis shugs bstan dri bzang gi chus bkang*/

ku sha rma bya'i sgro dang bcas pas kha brgyan/ rnam 'joms kyi skabs su rma bya'i sgro 'dzugs pa rgya gzhung dang yig rnying 'gar bshad kyi gzhan du 'bras bu can gyi shing gi yal ga'am/ ku sha kho nas brgyan par gsungs pas rang re'i 'di mdzes chos sam las slar shor bar mngon te mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog gis shes so// mchod pa rnams g.yas skor du bsham pa'i bum pa'i mdun du 'das gtor dang*/ g.yas ngos su phyi nang gang bder cha gsum gtor ma bsham/ bsham tshul ni sbyong dkyil/ rdor phreng*/ mi 'khrugs pa/ seng ge sgra sogs ngor lugs kyi chog khrigs phal mo che dang*/ kun rigs spar gyi mchan sogs las dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub nas brtsams te shar lho'i bar rim par bsham par bshad cing sa ngor thub gsum sogs grwa sa rnams kyi phyag len dkyus ma'ang de ga yin la rgyu mtshan cung zad kyang yod/ bu lugs kyi dkyil chog 'gar yang de bzhin du bshad/ 'on kyang rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil chog kho nar shar lho nas lho nub bar bsham par bshad pa ni 'das gtor dang sgos chos skyong gtor ma yod pa'i gral 'thud yin gsung srol yod cing tshe chog la'ang de ltar mdzad mod cung zad zhig dpyad dgos par 'dug kha cig spyi mchod kyis cha gsum gyi mchod pa'i go yang chod dgos pa'i phyir nang du nges par bsham zer mod/ der ma nges te spyi mchod ni bdag mdun bum gsum ka'i yin pas sgrub pa po yang spyi mchod kyi nang du 'dug dgos pa dang*/ cho ga gzhan la bum pa yang der 'jog dgos pa'i thal ba bzlog tu med/ ngag 'don gzhan dkyus bzhin la bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa snga ma la dharmā ra ṇi ta dang dril gsil mi mdzad/ thal mo sbyar te bstod pa bya/ rjes ma dril gsil sogs mdzad srol yod/ bum bskyed dkyus bzhin la/ dbang lha'i gsol 'debs tshe chog ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes brjod na legs te māṃ zhes pa'i sgra bdag la zhes 'gyur bas so// mchod bstod kyi rjes su/

bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du bsgrub bya 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod pas thugs ka'i nang gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gi 'og tu sbyin bdag sogs rang rang gi cha lugs ltar gsal btab/ pad kor gyis gzungs thag blangs rang gi snying ga nas sogs dkyus bzhin la bzlas pa'i tshe rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng spros pa hūm̐ de la phog de las bdud rtsi babs pa bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas thim pa'i dmigs pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya ba las sngags phreng bkod mi dgos so// mjug gi mchod 'bul tshigs bcad spro na 'jig rten khams 'di ma'am/ mchod yon phal cher ma gang rung bya/ phyogs 'byung gnyis kyi gtor ma byin rlabs kyang badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs 'das gtor dang 'dra/ bgegs 'gugs pa'i sngon du yang snying brjod/ bgegs gtor dor tshar ba dang mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa dang sbyong chas kyi ting lo sbar te theb kyu la chab bran/ bshad pa'i brda sprod pa la mos na 'di skad do// 'dir rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgo nas bkru byabs srung gsum gyi cho ga sgrub pa la gnyis te lo rgyus dang*/ cho ga dngos so// dang po ni sngon gyi dus su rgya gar gyi yul du rgyal po log pa'i snying po zhes bya bas rgyal srid chos srid dang mi mthun par bskyangs pas/ dkar phyogs kyi 'byung po rnams 'khrugs te rgyal khams su nad yams 'khrugs rtsod mu ge la sogs pa mi bde ba dpag tu med pa byung zhing*/ rgyal po rang yang nad drag pos thebs pas btsun mo blon 'bangs dang bcas sdug bsngal gyis non par gyur to// de'i tshe ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mthu stobs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje bskul te des kyang byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'i rnam par thar pas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud 'di rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la bshad/

de dag gis kyang rgyal po log pa'i snying po 'khor dang bcas pa la bshad/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis gus pas nyan cing nyams su blangs pa la brten nas nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing*/ rgyal khams bde bas khyab par gyur to// de lta bu'i phan yon dang mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud de nyid las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa la brten nas 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub so sos rgyud sde bzhi gang rung ltar bkral ba'i lugs srol du ma zhig byung ba las/ bya rgyud ltar gtsang sbra'i kun spyod kyis sgrub pa'i gdams pa lag len dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyang ston pa sangs rgyas nas kho bo'i bar rim gyis byon pa lags/ cho ga dngos la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang bsgrub bya la bya ba'i rim pa gnyis las dang po ni kho bos sngon du legs par grub zin pa yin/ gnyis pa la'ang gsum ste/ sngon 'gro sbyong ba rnam pa gsum bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bkru byabs srung gsum/ rjes bden pa'i stobs brjod cing shes par bya ba'o// de'i dang po la'ang rdzas dang sngags gnyis ka zhi bas sbyong ba dang*/ rdzas zhi ba la sngags drag po ste zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang*/ rdzas dang sngags gnyis ka drag po'i sgo nas sbyong ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs la gtor ma byin te sbyang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ theb kyu snod dang bcas dbus g.yas g.yon gyi rim par blangs te/ oṃ sarba bighān sogs brjod cing bsgrub bya la g.yas su bskor zhing snod gcig tu gsag gnyis pa ting lo dang changs bu sbyin te sbyang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag sngar bzhin blangs te bskor zhing*/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa sogs brjod/ gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa sogs nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod bcas sngon du 'gro bas bden pa bdar ba dang mnyam du de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros shing*/

yungs kar gyi thun rnams kyang khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dpag tu med par gyur te gdon bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas 'gyur ro// yang snying bzla zhing yungs kar 'thor/ gu gul gyis bdug go /slar yang 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs nas yang snying bzla ba'i bar lan gnyis te yongs dril lan gsum bya/ gong du khro bo spyan 'dren sogs ma byas kyang rung bas/ de ltar na bshad pa'i skabs su gsum pa ni/ yungs kar gyi thun rnams kyang khro bo'i rdo rje sogs dang sbrel zhing bden bdar phyi ma gnyis kyi mgor bstod pa yang mi dgos so// dngos gzhi bkru byabs srung gsum las dang po bkru ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rnams kyi gdong dang yan lag la sogs pa bkrus pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sgo gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad me long g.ya' phyis pa ltar sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thog mar bum chus kha bshal/ de nas 'thung du gzhug dril gsil dang bcas ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐ bar dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ bum chu spyi bo nas blugs cing*/ gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba bi gh+nan bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ= sarba ro ge bh+yaḥ= sarba duṣ+ṭān bh+yaḥ= sarba gra he= sarba dz+wā re= sarba byā de= sarba u pa dra we= sarba a kā la mṛ d+yu= sarba dur swap+ni= sarba durni mit+te= sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o// khar bum chu 'dzin du bcug la/ gnyis pa byab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal btab ste/
