de nyid slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje dang lhan cig tu bzung ste khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bskor zhing byabs pa la brten nas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags len pa ltar blangs te rgya mtsho chen por dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying gi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā sogs nas sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā zhes kha nang gi chu khrus gzhong du dor ro// tshar grangs bsags dgos na gong gi gzungs ring nas 'di bar bkru ba re dang byabs pa re spel zhing grangs bzung ngo*// gsum pa srung ba'am slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te/ gnas mdun du rdo rjes rig pas rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung ste/ lus la rdo rje'i go bgos nas phyin chad bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gnas de dag tu rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing*/ yang snying gi mthar rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes brjod/ bsdu na rdo rje spyi bo kho nar bzhag cing*/ yang snying gi mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes sbyar bas 'thus so// rjes bden pa'i stobs brjod cing shis par bya ba ni/ slar yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas tshogs gnyis mngon du mdzad pa'i bden pa dang*/ mtshan rtog gis mi chod cing*/ mi shigs pa la sogs pa'i che ba can/ chos nyid ye shes kyi rdo rje don gyi gzungs/ bdud sde rnam par 'joms pa'i lha sngags kyi rol mor shar ba'i bden pa'i dpung gis kyang bsrung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces dang*/ slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang bcas pas bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ ston mchog dam pa'am/ che ba'i che mchog ma gang rung gi mthar/ 'byung po gang dag dang nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod do// bsgrub bya rang gnas su btang la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum bsrungs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis bsngo smon dang*/ shis brjod ci rigs par bya'o// ༈ /rjes gnang dang 'brel bar khrus chog byed na/ sbyor ba'i skabs su tshom bu'i mthar mchod gtor bsham/ bum pa spyi ltar slob dpon gyi mdun du 'jog ngag 'don la bdag bskyed kyi rjes su tshom bu bsang sbyang lhar bskyed nas mchod bstod kyi bar bya/ de nas bum sgrub dkyus ltar la gtor ma mi 'bul bar mchod bstod kyi rjes su dngos grub blang ba bzod gsol lha 'od zhu bcas bya/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas mdun bskyed la 'bul/ cha gsum btang la mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma la rjes gnang yig cha dkyus la mtshams sbyor zur du yod pa sbrags nas bya zhing*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi rjes su/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mtha' rten du bkru byabs srung gsum gyi cho ga sgrub par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro sbyang ba gsum dang zhes pa man sngar bzhin byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya'o// rjes gnang rkyang pa la/ bum sgrub dang*/ cha gsum gtor ma sogs dor ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// rnam 'joms kyi bdag bum la brten nas kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen bya ba'i tshul ni zur 'debs snga ma mang du bzhugs mod/

'di nyid gdams pa zab mo zur pa zhig yin gshis/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i gzhung de'i lung nges par thob dgos par snang bas/ lung rgyun la phan du re bas gzhung de la mchan zhib mor btab yod pas mkhyen dpyod phyogs su ma lhungs pa rnams kyis der gzigs par zhu/ zhes pa 'di ni don gnyer du ma'i ngor rgyal khams pa ngag dbang legs grub kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
